skills.name: applicant-kit
skills.description: Agent skill that writes the better version of your application material: decoded JD table, action-task-result-impact bullets, honest keyword placement, five resume summaries, a LinkedIn rewrite, 20 interview answers. Only experience you already have; nothing invented. Sibling recruiter-lens does the judging. For Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Qoder.

skills.name: application-pilot
skills.description: Runs the job search around the applications: live shortlist from your criteria, rubric-based fit scores with evidence, a reviewable tracker with follow-up dates, aging flags, drafted follow-ups, interview briefings and a weekly funnel read. Never submits, never invents. No CLI, no telemetry, no browser automation.

skills.name: crash-test
skills.description: Agent skill that crash-tests a decision before you build it. Four fixed roles (Pragmatist, Skeptic, Specialist, Contrarian) draft alone, review each other anonymously, then a chair merges what survives and grounds its claims against your source before adopting. Dissent log included. Optional Operator seat. Zero setup: no server, no keys.

skills.name: do-better
skills.description: Agent skill: a tournament of sub-agents over one task. Every competitor gets the identical task and a different strategy card, then attacks, defends, and a judge scores each match on a written rubric until one champion survives. For when a retry won't fix the answer. Qoder CLI skill, Claude Code plugin. Adapted from Arena (MIT).

skills.name: draft-skill
skills.description: Agent skill that creates a new skill from an idea: confirms the purpose before writing, checks installed siblings for overlap, splits scripts/references/assets, writes a description that triggers, validates with check_skill.py. Qoder, Claude Code.

skills.name: findable
skills.description: Agent skill that sets up discovery for a GitHub repo, agent skill, Claude Code plugin or MCP server: audits where you rank today, derives the queries strangers type, drafts About text, topics, README opening, release notes and a site page, lists directories and plans a dated re-check. Never invents stars, rankings or sample output.

skills.name: findable-polish
skills.description: Audits content for discoverability gaps with Findable, then generates improved alternatives with Wordsmith. Use to improve SEO, search visibility, or findability of repo READMEs, skill pages, landing pages, articles — and get both diagnosis and concrete rewrites. Chains findable → wordsmith. Not for tuning SKILL.md triggers (use tune-skill).

skills.name: keyword-guard
skills.description: Agent skill that plans SEO topic clusters and ends keyword cannibalization, so one page wins each query. It maps query ownership before any title, H1 or content change, from Search Console or a sitemap when you lack GSC access. Covers on-page, link-authority and hreflang checks. White-hat, no API keys. Runs in Claude Code, Cursor, Qoder.

skills.name: keyword-resolver
skills.description: Resolves keyword cannibalization with Keyword-Guard, then generates alternatives with Wordsmith. Eliminates page competition, assigns query ownership from Search Console/sitemap, de-conflicts mixed-language pages with hreflang, builds cluster maps. Chains keyword-guard → wordsmith. Not for technical SEO diagnosis (use seo-audit).

skills.name: pre-ship-performance-audit
skills.description: Agent skill that audits and fixes a web app's real-world speed before launch: four read-only subagents check twenty known slow-downs across images, bundles, database queries and servers, then the same mobile Lighthouse run, three times before and after, proves each fix. Never removes a feature for a score, never invents a baseline; asks first before dependency, database or region changes.

skills.name: pre-ship-security-red-team
skills.description: Agent skill that red-teams a web app you own before launch: three subagents run 14 authorization and abuse checks (IDOR, role escalation, quota races, open redirects, XSS, SSRF, cache leaks, prompt injection) with captured evidence, then fix and rerun. Local isolated environments only. Claude Code, Cursor, Qoder.

skills.name: prompts-to-skill
skills.description: Agent skill that turns a list of your own prompts into a finished, tested skill. Intent interview, overlap check against installed skills, draft with draft-skill, trigger test cases, tune-skill gates. Qoder, Claude Code.

skills.name: prompts-to-skill-release
skills.description: Agent skill that packages a finished skill for release: runs its trigger test cases and records what passed, sets the version and CHANGELOG, builds the zip, writes the README, gives a per-platform install checklist. Failed tests stay visible.

skills.name: publish-release-gate
skills.description: Publishes a skill through three distribution channels: marketplace plugin, agent discovery protocol, and tarball delivery via Cloudflare Pages custom domain.

skills.name: recruiter-lens
skills.description: Agent skill that reviews resumes, CVs and LinkedIn profiles the way recruiters screen them: 6-second scan, ATS check, rejection reasons, gaps against a job description, likely interview questions. It never invents a metric. Its sibling applicant-kit writes the fix. For Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Qoder.

skills.name: release-gate
skills.description: Runs three pre-launch passes (exposure, app-tests, perf) in sequence and returns one release posture — HOLD or ready — with three separate verdicts and one merged finding register.

skills.name: seo-polish
skills.description: Audits SEO health with Seo-Audit, then generates optimized alternatives with Wordsmith. Full technical + on-page diagnosis with rewrites for titles, meta descriptions, headings, content gaps, internal linking. Chains seo-audit → wordsmith. Not for keyword cannibalization (use keyword-resolver) or mass pages (use programmatic-seo).

skills.name: skill-launch
skills.description: Launches one new skill from an idea: drafts with Draft-Skill, validates and tunes with Tune-Skill, then audits and polishes discoverability with Findable-Polish. Not for a batch of prompts you already wrote (use prompts-to-skill) or an existing skill (use tune-and-polish).

skills.name: topic-primer
skills.description: Agent skill for Claude Code, Cursor and Qoder that teaches any topic you name, from absolute zero to expert depth, in 8 modes: foundation, curriculum, concept chains, adaptive tutor, mental models, pitfalls, examiner, ELI5. One question at a time, honest grading, every term defined, no fabricated facts or resources.

skills.name: tune-and-polish
skills.description: Tunes triggers and boundaries with Tune-Skill, then polishes discovery with Findable-Polish — use it only when you want both halves at once. A triggering-only fix belongs to tune-skill, a listing-only one to findable-polish. Not for creating skills (use draft-skill).

skills.name: tune-skill
skills.description: Agent skill that audits and fine-tunes a skill that already exists: triggering descriptions, sibling overlaps, stale names and counts, handoff contracts, minimal evidenced edits. Ships check_skill.py, a deterministic SKILL.md validator. Qoder, Claude Code.

skills.name: upstream-check
skills.description: Agent skill that finds unpushed local commits and fast-forwards only the safe ones, plus checks published listings against the repos that actually ship a SKILL.md.

skills.name: upstream-polish
skills.description: Audits upstream drift/listing mismatches with Upstream-Check, generates polished fixes with Wordsmith. Reconciles repos with marketplace/site/README, fixes drifted descriptions/topics, cleans boundaries after push. Diagnosis + rewrites. Chains upstream-check → wordsmith. Not for creating skills (use draft-skill).

skills.name: web-preflight
skills.description: Agent skill for a pre-launch website check on a site you own: before you deploy, it looks for exposed .env, .git, config and debug files. Status codes are signals, not findings: it tells a real /.env leak from an SPA catch-all 200 or a blanket WAF 403, and marks unrun checks INCONCLUSIVE, never a false pass. No exploitation or port scanning.

skills.name: wordsmith
skills.description: Agent skill for Claude Code, Cursor and Qoder that drafts, rewrites, tightens and proofreads text. 44 commands over 5 disciplines: build, evaluate, refine, adapt, prepare. Meaning, facts, hedges and the author's voice carry through; shaky claims get flagged for checking instead of papered over.
